name: google-marketing-mcp
description: Google Ads, Analytics (GA4) and Search Console over MCP. Prompts for its credentials at install time; nothing is stored in this repo.

GOOGLE_PROJECT_ID.title: GCP project
GOOGLE_PROJECT_ID.description: Quota and billing project for the Ads and Analytics APIs. `gcloud config get-value project`.

GOOGLE_ADS_DEVELOPER_TOKEN.title: Google Ads developer token
GOOGLE_ADS_DEVELOPER_TOKEN.description: Google Ads → Tools → API Center. Needs at least Explorer access. Leave empty if you do not use Google Ads.

GOOGLE_ADS_LOGIN_CUSTOMER_ID.title: Manager (MCC) customer ID
GOOGLE_ADS_LOGIN_CUSTOMER_ID.description: Only when you access accounts through a manager account. Digits only, no dashes.

GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS.title: Service account JSON
GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS.description: Leave empty to use your gcloud Application Default Credentials, which is the usual choice.

GSC_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRETS_FILE.title: Search Console OAuth client secrets
GSC_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRETS_FILE.description: OAuth client JSON from the GCP console. This is what lets Search Console see every property you already have access to, instead of needing a service account added by hand to each one.
